verdict.rationale: Swell's key-based auth explicitly separates test (sk_test_) from live (sk_live_) environments, meaning developers—including AI agents—can operate against a test store without touching production data. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox' provisioning workflow, seed/reset tooling, or agent-specific guidance on using test mode safely. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-store provisioning docs, agent-oriented guidance on safe test usage, and independent confirmation of test-environment isolation in practice.
